summary: Verified new window.print() + #bon approach replacing the previous iframe autoprint. Kiosk web E2E (PIN 4321 → location → apartment → Vooruitbetaling SRD 5,00 → Contant → Confirm → ReceiptScreen): after ~3.5s window.__printCalls===1, document.getElementById('bon') exists as a direct body child (bonCount=1), contains receipt text (SuriRent N.V. / KWITANTIE / KW2026-00544 / Kevin Doelahasori / SRD 500,00 / CONTANT), #bon is display:none on screen, and NO iframes with 'print' in id/testid exist. Manual reprint click bumps __printCalls to 2 while bonCount stays exactly 1. Print media emulation: #bon computed display='block', #root computed display='none'. page.pdf(prefer_css_page_size=True) produced a PDF with page width 163.92pt ≈ 58mm, height 246.96pt (dynamic, not A4/Letter), content not clipped. Backend: /api/payments/{id}/print.html?fragment=1 returns a <style> with ALL CSS rules scoped under '#bon' plus <div class="sheet">; ?format=thermal&preview=1 and ?format=a4 still return full HTML 200. 3/3 pytest passes.
critical_code_review_comments: Observation (not a blocker): Under page.emulate_media('print') one unrelated direct body-child iframe (3rd-party/dev widget, no id/testid) still shows computed display:block despite the '!important' rule 'body > *:not(#bon) { display: none !important; }'. The receipt PDF output is clean (only #bon rendered) so this does not affect printing — likely the iframe is injected by Emergent dev tooling and sets display via a shadow/UA stylesheet or late-mounted inline style. No action required but worth noting if we later host a prod widget iframe as a body child.

lib/kiosk-print.js:fitPageToBon measures offsetHeight after setting bon to position:fixed/left:-10000px/width:54mm — good: it avoids layout shift. The '@page { size: 58mm Xmm }' is written to <style id=bon-page-size>. Make sure fitPageToBon runs BEFORE window.print(); it does (synchronous). ✓

The APK sendApkPrint() in KioskLayout.jsx still emits 'console.log([APK PRINT_RECEIPT], msg)' BEFORE the ReactNativeWebView check — repeat finding from iter71. Pure noise in web mode (fires once); not blocking.
Backend _render_receipt_html_thermal fragment branch correctly scopes every rule under '#bon' (prefix 'S' used in comp_css = '#bon '). Verified by regex in test. ✓

index.css @media print rule 'body > *:not(#bon) { display: none !important }' uses the single-selector :not — fine for a direct child filter; combined with 'html,body { overflow: visible }' this gives a clean 58mm page.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (auto-print, manual reprint, print-media CSS, 58mm PDF all verified)
